site.sitedescription: Peat exposure located on the coast of St. Lawrence Island. Surroundig vegetation: diverse herb-Salix tundra, with Salix polaris and S. pulchra being the most common woody species in the local vegetation. Graminoids are especially abundant with Alopecurus alpinus typical of boggy areas. Although the relief is modest, south-facing slopes support Artemisia tilesii, A. borealis, Salix arctica, and S. ovalifolia. Salix arctica, S. polaris, S. reticulata, S. ovalifolia, and S. pulchra are found near the. lagoon beach.
